sentences.en: He prevailed on the farmers to try the new seeds.
sentences.zh: 他说服了农民们试用新的种子。

sentences.en: From the rotten seed comes to us the nutritious fruit.
sentences.zh: 从腐烂的种子中长出了营养丰富的果实。

sentences.en: Not a seed at home, but call me Bajirao nonetheless.
sentences.zh: 家里连一粒种子都没有，却还叫我巴吉拉奥。

senses.zh: 种子；根据；精液；萌芽；子孙；原由
